system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

exchanges.user:
ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
The Seller’s draft is not acceptable as a package. Recommendations below follow Wattlebridge’s playbook; the Seller’s statements are positions to negotiate, not agreed terms.

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | General Warranty Claims capped at **20% / AUD 4.8m**. | **25% / AUD 6m**. The 20% fallback requires prior written approval from Amelia Frost; none is given. | **Reject; propose 25% / AUD 6m** — the conditional fallback is not authorised. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | **AUD 25,000** de minimis and **AUD 250,000** tipping basket, with only the excess recoverable. | **AUD 5,000** de minimis and **AUD 50,000** aggregate basket, with liability from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Reject; propose playbook thresholds and tipping recovery** — the Seller’s thresholds materially narrow recovery. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | **18 months** after Completion; proposes limitations apply to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise. | **24 months** for general claims; do not accept a general rule that silently shortens other claim regimes. | **Reject; propose 24 months and preserve separate regimes** — 18 months is an unauthorised fallback. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties subject to general caps and time limits. | Separate regime: **100% cap**, at least **six years**, outside the general basket, de minimis and knowledge bar. | **Reject; specify the separate regime** — title and capacity should not be diluted by general limitations. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply to all Claims; no express fraud carve-out is stated. | Fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct carved out of all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable; this cannot be waived. | **Require an express comprehensive carve-out** — the draft risks applying restrictions to conduct that must remain outside them. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | General disclosure of the data room, Accounts, statutory registers and public records; specific disclosures also listed. | Specific fair disclosure; reject deemed disclosure of the whole data room, public registers or matters found by prudent search. | **Reject broad general disclosure; retain only specific fair disclosures** — blanket incorporation obscures what was actually disclosed. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | Bars claims for matters known by Buyer or advisers, including matters discoverable in the data room or public records. | Delete blanket knowledge exclusions. Any qualifier must identify Seller knowledge persons and require reasonable enquiry; never apply to title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnities. | **Delete or tightly limit the clause** — constructive or adviser knowledge should not become a blanket defence. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; consent treated as satisfied on delivery of written consent. No final consent or evidence conditions are included in the disclosure. | Effective consent **and evidence its conditions are satisfied before Completion**; reasonable endeavours alone is insufficient for this material customer. | **Make both items conditions to Completion** — delivery alone does not establish an effective consent or satisfied conditions. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately **AUD 3.2m** to be addressed by a release following Completion; disclosure says it remains unpaid and no final discharge is included. | Current payout, repayment directly from Completion funds and effective security releases. Any post-Completion release requires an irrevocable undertaking and Amelia Frost’s approval. | **Require completion funds repayment and releases** — a later release leaves the Buyer exposed to outstanding debt and security. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | **AUD 420,000** bonuses are for Seller’s account and are not separately itemised in the funds flow; on-costs are unspecified. | DD-005 bonuses **plus triggered on-costs** as a specific line item or Seller-funded, reflected in funds flow. | **Require an explicit funded line item or Seller funding** — the current funds flow silently omits a known potential Completion cost. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; DD-010 records **AUD 180,000 open**, but this is not independently bank-verified, with no receipt or confirmatory assignment in the data room. | Broaden the indemnity beyond the payment issue while preserving the SOW3 cure; do not treat the AUD 180,000 as independently verified either way. | **Broaden the indemnity and retain the cure** — payment alone may not resolve transfer or ownership risk, and the amount remains unverified. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Characterised as preliminary and not expected to be material; disclosure records an unintended link delivery but does not establish access, scope, notification duty or loss. | Preserve logs, investigate and require updates; assume **no confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand** on this record. | **Require preservation, investigation and updates without assuming liability or no risk** — the facts remain preliminary and need verification. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | Three renewals total **AUD 330,000**, characterised as ordinary-course operating costs. | Assess timing, scope, avoidability, termination and accrual; no automatic Debt classification or price deduction. | **Investigate and assess under the agreed price mechanics** — the disclosure does not establish whether the costs are unavoidable, accrued or ordinary course. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | Limitations and general regime asserted to apply broadly; Seller says tax and IP are settled under that regime. | Keep Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant categories separate; no hidden general-regime override. | **Reject blanket application and map each category expressly** — broad language could unintentionally override negotiated category-specific protections. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | Relies on the DD-012 share register recording Seller as holder of 100%; no independent proof is provided. | Independent evidence of title, ownership, encumbrances and authority; DD-012 is a supplied internal source, not independent verification. | **Require independent verification and supporting evidence** — the register is the Seller-identified source, not a substitute for Buyer verification. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Seller considers Tax and IP positions settled under the general regime. | Keep Tax and IP terms **open**; assume neither unlimited liability nor resolution. | **Do not accept the Seller’s settlement assertion** — the playbook records these terms as open and provides no basis for treating them as resolved. |
=== END ADVICE ===
